control.notes: flask 2.0.2 FlaskClient.open passes as_tuple=as_tuple to werkzeug.test.Client.open. werkzeug 2.1.0 removed as_tuple; Client.open now takes *args, **kwargs and passes them to EnvironBuilder, which raises TypeError. griffe's removed-parameter list does not include Client.open's as_tuple, probably because the signature became *args/**kwargs (not confirmed), so the graph had no removed parameter to trace and the exclusion is a false negative. Any user calling app.test_client().get/post/open breaks.
